findings.summary: The blocker of rounds 0-3 is resolved, but not by this unit. tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts changed at 2026-10-26 00:27:21, after the interrupted r3 attempt, outside these write paths (it is in none). Its content is exactly the AC-ra-37 patch proposed in rounds 1-3; only the import path differs from the scratch copy. This attempt did not edit it. With it, `pnpm exec playwright test --project=fresh-db` passes 5/5, `pnpm test:e2e` passes 91/91 and harness RG-smoke passes. QA should review this file as a change outside every unit.

For future plans: plan L583 runs tests/e2e/firstRun.spec.ts, but no unit listed it in its files. The engine could not route the repair (externalRepairPaths() only routes files that some unit owns), and the supervisor looped for 3 rounds until the file was changed by hand. A spec that a feature makes stale should be in the files of the unit that changes the behaviour.

The declared paths src/features/reports/* now live in src/features/report-center/*. They were renamed earlier in this run because the aioson packager drops every folder named 'reports'. The edited ReportCenterPage.tsx and PortfolioReportPage.tsx are the renamed declared paths. Recreating src/features/reports/ would break the store package again.
Not changed; the behaviour is verified by e2e. ConsultantHomeData has no awaitingQuestionnaires and CompanyAttention has no 'aguardando', so three pages widen the types locally. Type hygiene only.

Not changed: the data-aioson-tour anchors 'relatorios', 'marca' and 'modo' are absent, and the tour uses its data-aioson-id fallbacks. home.spec.ts and the scratch firstRun copy confirm that the 5 steps highlight 5 distinct regions in both modes.

The questionnaire and answers file names are slugified ('studio-norte-questionario-2026-10-25.html'), while the PDFs keep the version 1 names with spaces ('Studio Norte-2026-10-25.pdf'). The owner may want one convention.

The live Play preview (port 3543) holds data/fitpulse.db. A pnpm reinstall's postinstall migrate deploy therefore fails with 'database is locked'. In the previous attempt, one install was run against a run-scoped temp database. The preview was not touched; `pnpm dev` applies the 4 new migrations on its next start.

Owner-approved Q-10 test: open a generated questionnaire file in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari on a computer with no internet, answer it, save, and import the answers. The e2e already covers Chromium offline with no network request.

Report center open in the Play dev-link (Settings -> Instalar App -> Linkar pasta): green badge, Relatórios tab, preview and export.

Update a version 1 installation that has data through the Play, and check that companies, diagnoses, drafts and preferences are kept. scripts/smoke-store-package.mjs reproduces this flow and passes.
